37016-elements-of-morals-with-special-ap.title: Elements Of Morals With Special Application Of The Moral Law
37016-elements-of-morals-with-special-ap.creator: Unknown
37016-elements-of-morals-with-special-ap.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "He supplies," says a writer in the _British Quarterly Review_,[1] in a notice of his _Theory of Morals_, "the very element to which Mr. Sully gives so little place. He cannot conceive morals without religion. Stated shortly, his position is, that moral good is founded upon a natural and essential good, and that the domains of good and of duty are absolutely equivalent.

arxiv-1911-03183.title: Privacy-Preserving Generalized Linear Models using Distributed Block Coordinate Descent
arxiv-1911-03183.creator: Erik-Jan van Kesteren, Chang Sun, Daniel L. Oberski, Michel Dumontier, Lianne Ippel †
arxiv-1911-03183.description: Abstract Combining data from varied sources has considerable potential for knowledge discovery: collaborating data parties can mine data in an expanded feature space, allowing them to explore a larger range of scientific questions. However, data sharing among different parties is highly restricted by legal conditions, ethical concerns, and / or data volume.

arxiv-2102-01049.title: (Un-)bounded transition fronts for the parabolic Anderson model and the randomized F-KPP equation
arxiv-2102-01049.creator: Jiří ČernýAlexander Drewitz, Lars Schmitz
arxiv-2102-01049.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jiří ČernýAlexander Drewitz, Lars Schmitz. We investigate the uniform boundedness of the fronts of the solutions to the randomized Fisher-KPP equation and to its linearization, the parabolic Anderson model. It has been known that for the standard (i.e. deterministic) Fisher-KPP equation, as well as for the special case of a randomized Fisher-KPP equation with so-called ignition type nonlinearity, one has a uniformly bounded (in time) transition front.

arxiv-2111-11578.title: Generative Adversarial Networks for Astronomical Images Generation
arxiv-2111-11578.creator: Davide Coccomini, Nicola Messina, Claudio Gennaro, Fabrizio Falchi
arxiv-2111-11578.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Davide Coccomini, Nicola Messina, Claudio Gennaro, Fabrizio Falchi. Space exploration has always been a source of inspiration for humankind, and thanks to modern telescopes, it is now possible to observe celestial bodies far away from us. With a growing number of real and imaginary images of space available on the web and exploiting modern Deep Learning architectures such as Generative Adversarial Networks, it is now possible to generate new representations of space.

arxiv-2205-04712.title: Knowledge Augmented Machine Learning with Applications in Autonomous Driving: A Survey
arxiv-2205-04712.creator: Julian Wörmann 7 , Daniel Bogdoll 9 , Christian Brunner 6 , Etienne Bührle 9 , Han Chen 2 , Evaristus Fuh Chuo 2 , Kostadin Cvejoski 8 , Ludger van Elst 4 , Philip Gottschall 8 , Stefan Griesche 10 , Christian Hellert 3 , Christian Hesels 8 , Sebastian Houben 8 , Tim Joseph 9 , Niklas Keil 1 , Johan
arxiv-2205-04712.description: Abstract Abstract: The availability of representative datasets is an essential prerequisite for many successful artificial intelligence and machine learning models. However, in real life applications these models often encounter scenarios that are inadequately represented in the data used for training. There are various reasons for the absence of sufficient data, ranging from time and cost constraints to ethical considerations.

arxiv-2211-04580.title: Quantum triangles and imaginary geometry flow lines
arxiv-2211-04580.creator: Morris Ang Xin Sun Pu Yu
arxiv-2211-04580.description: Abstract We define a three-parameter family of random surfaces in Liouville quantum gravity (LQG) which can be viewed as the quantum version of triangles. These quantum triangles are natural in two senses. First, by our definition they produce the boundary three-point correlation functions of Liouville conformal field theory on the disk.

arxiv-2301-04771.title: Variational Inference: Posterior Threshold Improves Network Clustering Accuracy in Sparse Regimes
arxiv-2301-04771.creator: Xuezhen Li xzhli@ucdavis.edu, Can M. Le canle@ucdavis.edu
arxiv-2301-04771.description: Abstract Variational inference has been widely used in machine learning literature to fit various Bayesian models. In network analysis, this method has been successfully applied to solve community detection problems. Although these results are promising, their theoretical support is only for relatively dense networks, an assumption that may not hold for real networks.

arxiv-2401-10203.title: Remarks on Fixed Point Assertions in Digital Topology, 8
arxiv-2401-10203.creator: Laurence Boxer
arxiv-2401-10203.description: Abstract This paper continues a series in which we study deficiencies in previously published works concerning fixed point assertions for digital images. MSC: 54H25 Key words and phrases: digital topology, digital image, fixed point, digital metric space 1 Introduction There are many beautiful results concerning fixed points for digital images. There are also many highly flawed papers concerning this topic.

arxiv-2410-06237.title: BUMBLE: Unifying Reasoning and Acting with Vision-Language Models for Building-wide Mobile Manipulation Thanks: * Equal advising. Correspondence: rutavms@utexas.edu
arxiv-2410-06237.creator: Rutav Shah, Albert Yu, Yifeng Zhu, Yuke Zhu *, Roberto Martín-Martín *
arxiv-2410-06237.description: Abstract To operate at a building scale, service robots must perform very long-horizon mobile manipulation tasks by navigating to different rooms, accessing different floors, and interacting with a wide and unseen range of everyday objects. We refer to these tasks as Building-wide Mobile Manipulation.

arxiv-2501-10772.title: Asymptotically exact theory of functionally graded elastic beams
arxiv-2501-10772.creator: K. C. Le a,b , T. M. Tran c
arxiv-2501-10772.description: Abstract We construct a one-dimensional first-order theory for functionally graded elastic beams using the variational-asymptotic method. This approach ensures an asymptotically exact one-dimensional equations, allowing for the precise determination of effective stiffnesses in extension, bending, and torsion via numerical solutions of the dual variational problems on the cross-section.

arxiv-2505-00089.title: Approximation theory for Green’s functions via the Lanczos algorithm
arxiv-2505-00089.creator: Gabriele Pinna, Oliver Lunt, Curt von Keyserlingk
arxiv-2505-00089.description: Abstract It is known that Green’s functions can be expressed as continued fractions; the content at the n n -th level of the fraction is encoded in a coefficient b n b_{n} , which can be recursively obtained using the Lanczos algorithm.

arxiv-2509-12749.title: RandomMeas.jl: A Julia Package for Randomized Measurements in Quantum Devices
arxiv-2509-12749.creator: Andreas Elben, Benoît Vermersch
arxiv-2509-12749.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Andreas Elben, Benoît Vermersch. We introduce RandomMeas.jl , a modular and high-performance open-source software package written in Julia for implementing and analyzing randomized measurement protocols in quantum computing. Randomized measurements provide a powerful framework for extracting properties of quantum states and processes such as expectation values, entanglement, and fidelities using simple experimental procedures combined with classical post-processing, most prominently via the classical shadow formalism.

arxiv-2602-14549.title: Realization of a Synthetic Hall Torus with a Spinor Bose-Einstein Condensate
arxiv-2602-14549.creator: T. -H. Chien, S. -C. Wu, Y. -H. Su, L. -R. Liu, N. -C. Chiu, M. Sarkar, Q. Zhou, Y. -J. Lin
arxiv-2602-14549.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by T. -H. Chien, S. -C. Wu, Y. -H. Su, L. -R. Liu, N. -C. Chiu, M. Sarkar, Q. Zhou, Y. -J. Lin. We report the first experimental realization of a synthetic Hall torus using a spinor Bose-Einstein condensate confined in a ring-shaped trap with in situ imaging. By cyclically coupling three hyperfine spin states via Raman and microwave fields, we impose a periodic boundary condition in the synthetic dimension, which—together with a real-space ring trap—realizes a toroidal geometry with a synthetic magnetic flux.

pmc-10715785.title: HBV reactivation in patients with rheumatoid arthritis treated with anti-interleukin-6: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-10715785.creator: Stamatia Katelani, George E Fragoulis, Athanasios-Dimitrios Bakasis, Abraham Pouliakis, Elena Nikiphorou, Fabiola Atzeni, Theodoros Androutsakos
pmc-10715785.description: ObjectiveThe objective of this study was to assess the possibility of HBV reactivation (HBVr) in patients with RA under anti-IL-6 treatment.MethodsUsing PubMed, Scopus and EMBASE, we performed a systematic literature search for articles related to HBVr in RA patients under anti-IL-6 treatment. The search was performed with no date limits and was last updated 28 January 2023.

pmc-11479048.title: Investigating Causal Associations between the Gut Microbiota and Dementia: A Mendelian Randomization Study
pmc-11479048.creator: Zhi-Yuan Xiong, Hong-Min Li, Cheng-Shen Qiu, Xu-Lian Tang, Dan-Qing Liao, Li-Ying Du, Shu-Min Lai, Hong-Xuan Huang, Bing-Yun Zhang, Ling Kuang, Zhi-Hao Li
pmc-11479048.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: The causal association of specific gut microbiota with dementia remains incompletely understood. We aimed to access the causal relationships in which one or more gut microbiota account for dementia. Method: Using data from the MiBioGen and FinnGen consortia, we employed multiple Mendelian randomization (MR) approaches including two-sample MR (TSMR), multivariable MR (MVMR), and Bayesian model averaging MR to comprehensively evaluate the causal associations between 119 genera and dementia, and to prioritize the predominant bacterium.

pmc-13113823.title: Dietary Supplementation with GBE and TP Alleviates Heat Stress-Induced Lung Oxidative Damage in Broilers
pmc-13113823.creator: Xingyue Wu, Shuang Wu, Yuelong Chen, Lifang Si, Rui Zheng, Huaiyong Zhang, Siqiang Liu, Yanqun Huang, Wen Chen, Xuemeng Si
pmc-13113823.description: Simple SummaryHigh environmental temperatures are a major challenge for the poultry industry, as heat reduces feed intake, suppresses growth, and impairs animal health. This study aimed to investigate whether two natural plant-derived bioactive substances, ginkgo leaf extract and tea polyphenols, could help broiler chickens cope with heat stress.

pmc-13355751.title: Objective and perceived proximity to parks in relation to physical activity within parks
pmc-13355751.creator: Zhanjia Zhang, Xiao Hou, Zhengqing Zhou, Junwei Qian
pmc-13355751.description: ObjectivesUrban parks serve as important venues for promoting physical activity. This study aimed to examine the associations between both perceived and objective proximity to parks and within-park physical activity (PA) across different intensity levels among urban park users.MethodsThis cross-sectional study was conducted in four urban parks in Beijing, China.

pmc-13512851.title: Oleogels and Related Structured-Lipid Systems as Dual-Function Ingredients in Meat Products: Saturated Fat Replacement and Bioactive Delivery
pmc-13512851.creator: Bibiana Alves dos Santos, Néstor Sepúlveda, John Quiñones, Márcio Vargas-Ramella, Julián Andrés Gómez-Salazar, Paulo Cezar Bastianello Campagnol
pmc-13512851.description: Oleogels, in which liquid oils are structured into semi-solid matrices by oleogelators, have been widely investigated as animal fat replacers in meat products, where they lower saturated fatty acid content while helping preserve texture, structure, and emulsion stability. The reported gains are substantial: structuring PUFA-rich oils to replace pork backfat has raised the PUFA/SFA ratio around 3.
